responseLanguage.label: Answer language
responseLanguage.note: Changes apply to the next answer. Earlier answers stay as they are.

intro.tagline: An assistant that works on your phone, even without internet.
intro.pointDownload: Setup needs one download. After that, Namu works without internet.
intro.pointOnDevice: Answers are made on this phone. Your chats are not sent anywhere.
intro.pointMistakes: The AI can make mistakes. Check important information.

setup.title: Set up offline AI
setup.explain: Namu needs to download its offline AI package once. Chats do not need internet after that.
setup.wifiNote: Namu downloads on Wi‑Fi unless you choose mobile data.
setup.noConnection: No internet connection right now. Connect to download the offline AI package. Your saved chats and settings still work.
setup.meteredBody: About {{bytes}} still needs to be downloaded. Your mobile plan may charge for this data.
setup.ineligibleTitle: This version cannot run on this phone
setup.ineligibleMemory: Namu's offline AI needs a phone with about 6 GB of memory or more. This phone reports less.
setup.ineligibleOs: Namu needs Android 10 or newer, or iOS 17 or newer.
setup.ineligibleAbi: This phone's processor type is not supported by this version.
setup.ineligibleMetal: This device cannot run Namu's AI engine.
setup.ineligibleKeep: You can still read saved chats, change settings and open Help.
setup.needSpace: Free up {{bytes}} more storage to continue.
setup.descriptorInvalid: This copy of Namu cannot verify its download information. Update the app and try again.

progress.title: Setting up Namu
progress.cancelBody: The setup data downloaded so far will be removed. You can start again later.
progress.restarted: The download had to start again from the beginning. Earlier progress could not be reused.

chat.title: Namu
chat.promptSummarize: Summarize this text in a few short points:
chat.labelLength: Answer reached the length limit. Ask for more to continue.
chat.labelUnsaved: This text could not be saved. Copy it if you need it.
chat.trimmedNotice: Earlier messages are saved, but may no longer be used in this answer.
chat.returnToAnswer: Namu is answering in another chat
chat.busyBody: Namu can write one answer at a time. Stop the current answer to start a new one.
chat.linkBody: This opens {{host}} in your browser and uses internet.
chat.needsSetupTitle: Offline AI is not set up
chat.needsSetupBody: You can read saved chats. To get new answers, finish setup.
chat.tooLongInline: This message is too long. Shorten it to send.
chat.recoveryReadOnly: Saved chats are in recovery mode. You can read and export them.

conversations.title: Conversations
conversations.emptyBody: Chats you start are saved on this phone.
conversations.deleteBody: “{{title}}” and all its messages will be deleted from this phone. This cannot be undone.
conversations.deleteStopFirst: Namu is answering in this conversation. The answer will be stopped before deleting.

export.warningBody: The exported file is plain text. Once shared or saved elsewhere, Namu can no longer protect or delete it.
export.failed: The export could not be finished. Your chats are unchanged.

settings.title: Settings
settings.defaultResponseNote: Chats you already started keep their own setting.

storage.title: Offline storage
storage.upToDate: The offline AI is up to date.
storage.updateNote: Updates never start on their own. Namu keeps working while an update downloads.
storage.checkFailed: Namu could not check for updates. Try again when you are online.
storage.installUpdateNote: Installing pauses chat for a moment while Namu tests the new package.
storage.installFailed: The update did not pass its test, so Namu kept the current version.
storage.repairNote: Namu checks the offline AI file. If it is damaged, you can download it again.
storage.restoreBody: Namu will switch back to the offline AI version used before the last update.
storage.removeBody: Your chats stay on this phone, but Namu cannot write new answers until you download the offline AI again.
storage.chatsKept: Namu never deletes your chats to make room for the offline AI.
storage.busy: Namu could not confirm that the current answer stopped. Close and reopen the app, then try again.

privacy.title: Privacy and data
privacy.noUploadTitle: Your chats stay on this phone
privacy.noUploadBody: Namu does not upload your messages or answers. Answers are made by the offline AI on this device. Namu has no accounts and sends no usage statistics.
privacy.networkBody: Only to download or update the offline AI package when you ask, and when you choose to open a link. Like any download, those requests show ordinary network information such as your IP address to the download server.
privacy.backupBody: Chats, the offline AI and exports are kept out of automatic cloud and device-transfer backups where the phone allows it. If you change phones, export the chats you want to keep.
privacy.protectionBody: Chats are stored in Namu's private storage and rely on your phone's screen lock and built-in protection. Namu does not add its own password or encryption, and cannot protect data on a phone that is already unlocked or modified.
privacy.deletionNote: Deleting removes data from Namu. It is not a forensic wipe of the phone's storage.
privacy.deleteConversationsBody: All conversations, answers, drafts and search history will be deleted from this phone. The offline AI and your settings stay. This cannot be undone.
privacy.deleteEverythingBody: This deletes every conversation, the downloaded offline AI, exports and all settings, and returns Namu to its first screen. This cannot be undone.
privacy.deferred: Namu could not confirm that the AI engine stopped, so nothing was deleted. Close and reopen the app, then try again.

help.title: Help
help.downloadBody: Downloads pause when the connection drops and continue when it returns. If you paused it yourself, tap Resume. On iPhone, a download may need to start again if the app was force-closed. Keep Namu installed and stay on Wi‑Fi if you can.
help.storageBody: The offline AI needs about 2 GB plus 1 GB of free working space. Remove unused apps, photos or videos, then try again. Namu never deletes your chats to make space.
help.slowBody: Answers are made by your phone, so speed depends on the device. Close other apps, keep the phone cool and charged, and ask shorter questions. The first answer after opening Namu takes longer because the AI has to load.
help.heatBody: If the phone gets too warm, Namu stops the answer and waits until it has cooled down. Take off the case, move out of the sun and wait a minute before trying again.
help.missingTitle: The offline AI is missing or damaged
help.missingBody: Open Settings, then Offline storage. Repair checks the file, and you can download it again if needed. Your chats are not affected.
help.exportBody: Use the menu next to a conversation, or Privacy and data to export everything. Exports are plain text files that leave Namu's protection once shared.
help.uninstallBody: Uninstalling the app removes the offline AI and all chats from this phone. Export anything you want to keep first.
help.diagnosticsBody: Technical details that help find a problem. They contain no messages, answers, titles or file locations, and are never sent automatically.
help.contactNote: This opens your email app. Nothing is attached automatically.

about.title: About the AI
about.modelBody: Namu's answers come from Tiny Aya Global, an open-weights language model made by Cohere Labs. Namu did not train this model.
about.formatValue: GGUF, Q4_K_M quantization published by Cohere Labs
about.limitsBody: Namu does not browse the internet, does not know current news and cannot check facts. It can be wrong, especially about names, numbers, health, law and money. Quality differs between languages; Hausa and French answers may be less accurate than English. For important decisions, ask a qualified person.
about.licenseIntro: Tiny Aya Global is licensed by Cohere Labs under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 (CC BY-NC 4.0) with Cohere's acceptable use terms. The quantized GGUF file is distributed unmodified from Cohere Labs' official GGUF repository.
about.noticesBody: Namu includes the llama.cpp engine (MIT), DM Sans (SIL Open Font License 1.1), Material Symbols (Apache 2.0) and other open-source software.

DEVICE_INELIGIBLE.title: This version cannot run on this phone
DEVICE_INELIGIBLE.body: The offline AI cannot be downloaded to this phone. Saved chats and Help still work.

SPACE_LOW.title: More storage is needed
SPACE_LOW.body: Free up {{bytes}} more storage. The download is paused and nothing was lost.

NETWORK_WAIT.title: Waiting for a connection
NETWORK_WAIT.body: The download continues when the connection returns. Your progress is kept.

TRANSFER_RETRY.title: Download could not continue
TRANSFER_RETRY.body: What was downloaded so far is kept. Check your connection and try again.

TRANSFER_RESTART.title: Download must restart
TRANSFER_RESTART.body: The download has to start again from the beginning. Earlier progress cannot be reused.

SIGNATURE_INVALID.title: Update could not be verified
SIGNATURE_INVALID.body: Namu rejected the update information because it could not be verified. Your current offline AI keeps working.

FILE_DAMAGED.title: Download needs repair
FILE_DAMAGED.body: The downloaded file was damaged and has been removed. Your current offline AI and chats are safe.

MODEL_INCOMPATIBLE.title: Update needs another app version
MODEL_INCOMPATIBLE.body: This update does not work with this version of Namu. Update the app first. Your current offline AI keeps working.

MODEL_LOAD_FAILED.title: Offline AI could not start
MODEL_LOAD_FAILED.body: Namu did not load the AI again automatically. Your chats are safe. You can try again or repair the offline AI.

MEMORY_LOW.title: Not enough available memory
MEMORY_LOW.body: The answer was stopped and what was written is saved. Close other apps, then try again.

DEVICE_HOT.title: Phone needs to cool down
DEVICE_HOT.body: The answer was stopped to protect your phone. Namu will be ready again after the phone has cooled.

INPUT_TOO_LONG.title: Message is too long
INPUT_TOO_LONG.body: Your message is kept. Shorten it, or send it in smaller parts.

ANSWER_INTERRUPTED.title: Answer stopped before completion
ANSWER_INTERRUPTED.body: What was written is saved. You can try again.

STORAGE_WRITE_FAILED.title: Answer could not be saved
STORAGE_WRITE_FAILED.body: The answer was stopped because it could not be saved. The text is still on screen so you can copy it.

DATABASE_RECOVERY.title: Saved chats need recovery
DATABASE_RECOVERY.body: Namu opened your chats in read-only mode and did not delete anything. Export the conversations you need, then update the app.

CANCEL_TIMEOUT.title: Answer could not be stopped safely
CANCEL_TIMEOUT.body: New answers are turned off for now. Close Namu completely and open it again.
